name: Derived non-renewal new-maintenance tier formula
what_it_tests: A new (non-renewal) derived maintenance line computes net = tier-percent(AttributeValue) x contributor base (Source_List_Price__c / Base_Price__c) via the derived formula tiers; e.g. BoKS 355 x 20% = 71
proc_mechanism: Derived Pricing Formula (IF QuoteTypeText != Renewal: tier % by Maintenance Type Defn AttributeValue * Source_List_Price__c); Derived Products - Non-Renewal; Stamp Contributor Base (Pre-Discount)
expected_behavior: Net = tierPct(AttributeValue) x base (Base_Price__c, else Pre_Partner_Price, else InputUnitPrice fallback)
test_setup: New quote derived maintenance, license base present (e.g. PIA-PIA-NRPS-PIAP $355 + maint PIA-PIA-RNM-PIAMBK), AttributeValue='Standard' (0.20)
